jsonlOneJsonObjectPer: JSONL, one JSON object per line. Lines with type "user" / "assistant" are the conversation; the content is in message.content (a string, or an array where text blocks are text and tool_use / tool_result are tool calls and results). Other types (api-request, attachment, file-history-*, etc.) can be ignored. User entries containing tool_result are tool results, not something the user said.
jsonlOneJsonObjectPer2: JSONL, one JSON object per line. Entries with type=="response_item" and payload.type=="message" are the conversation; payload.role is user / assistant and the text is in payload.content[].text (the first few role=user entries may be injected content such as AGENTS.md or environment info). payload.type function_call / custom_tool_call are tool calls, *_output are their results; reasoning can be ignored.
jsonlOneJsonObjectPer3: JSONL, one JSON object per line. kind=="Prompt" is a user message, kind=="AssistantMessage" is a reply, with the text in the data of data.content[] items whose kind=="text"; kind=="ToolResults" are tool results and "Compaction" is a context compaction summary.
jsonlOneJsonObjectPer4: JSONL, one JSON object per line. Entries with type=="message" are the conversation; role is user / assistant and the text is in content[].text (content type input_text / output_text).
toolOfTheOriginalSession: Tool of the original session, e.g. Claude Code
absolutePathOfTheOriginal: Absolute path of the original session record
descriptionOfTheRecordFile: Description of the record file format (filled in per tool)
thisTaskWasPreviouslyWorked:
This task was previously worked on in {tool}; you are taking it over now. Working directory: {cwd}

Original session record: `{path}`
Format: {format}

First read the original session record to understand the earlier context, and check the current changes with git status / git diff / git log.

In this turn, only report back. Do not modify any files and do not continue the task. Please report:
- What the goal was
- What has been completed
- What is still unfinished, and where it stopped
- What you suggest as the next step
markdownExportedByYiConsole: Markdown exported by Yi Console from the session record: user messages, reply text and tool call summaries (tool output not included).
